label: Edu-ConvoKit: reasoning, focusing questions, uptake
summary: Marks the turns where the learner explains their reasoning, where the AI asks a focusing question, and where the AI builds on what the learner said, with Edu-ConvoKit's classifiers. Each is a model you download and turn on; none runs by default.
cite: Wang, R. E., & Demszky, D. (2024). Edu-ConvoKit: An Open-Source Library for Education Conversation Data. NAACL 2024 (System Demonstrations), 61-69. https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2024.naacl-demo.6
attribution: Edu-ConvoKit (Wang & Demszky, 2024), with the student reasoning classifier (Demszky & Hill, 2023), the focusing question classifier (Alic et al., 2022) and the uptake model (Demszky et al., 2021).

evidence.original: The reasoning and focusing question classifiers were trained on people's labels of 4th and 5th grade math classroom transcripts (NCTE); the uptake model learned from classroom transcripts without labels, was checked against experts' ratings, and its scores correlated with instruction quality in three datasets (Demszky et al., 2021). The best focusing question model correlated .76 with experts' labels (Alic et al., 2022); the one released is a BERT classifier with no reported agreement of its own. The NCTE paper's models found discourse moves that correlated with observation scores and outcomes (Demszky & Hill, 2023).
evidence.integration: Run through the adapter with Edu-ConvoKit 0.4.0 on the synthetic record in fixtures/; README.md says which classifiers were run. Its marks have not been compared with teachers' labels on learners' chats with an AI.
evidence.unknown: Whether classifiers trained on teachers and students talking in a classroom read a learner's typed chat with an AI the same way: nobody has checked. What a mark says about what a learner learned.

risk_notes: A wrong mark misleads a teacher. It runs on this computer, reads each model from this computer's cache and sends nothing elsewhere; downloading a model first (--download) contacts huggingface.co, with no learner's data. The models are for non-commercial use (CC BY-NC 3.0; CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 with terms) or say GPL with no version.
